item.title: [−3] Chennai Faces Growing Water Crisis as Northeast Monsoon Rainfall Falls Short
item.description:
Signal: weak monsoon or sowing. 3 reports from GK Today, The Times of India, LiveChennai. Related: “Rainfall Deficit Stresses Andhra Pradesh Kharif Crops”. Mixed: 2 reports point the other way. Ongoing: also reported on 4 of the previous 7 days (first 13 Nov).

Agri & fertilisers: strong headwind (−3) — Crop output at risk

Why it matters: Poor rains hurt harvests and rural incomes, weighing on rural demand and raising food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India-UK trade deal, Bangladesh ties, Nepal PM visit: Key takeaways from MEA briefing
item.description:

Confidence: high · horizon: months
